name: New Zealand
notes: House of Representatives: 120 seats under MMP (5% threshold or one electorate), 72 electorate seats (64 general + 7 Maori) plus list seats; an overhang can grow the house (122 in 2023). 2023 result: National 38.1% (48 seats), Labour 26.9% (34), Green 11.6% (15), ACT 8.6% (11), NZ First 6.1% (8), Te Pati Maori 3.1% (6, overhang). Election on 7 November 2026.
